The workflow validates successfully. Here is the final YAML:

workflow_id: wf_aw_003
steps:
  - id: receive_document
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      source: upload_pipeline
      resource: process_document
      timeout_seconds: 300
    output: raw_document

  - id: authenticate_pipeline
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      service: pipeline_service
      method: service_account
    output: auth_context

  - id: extract_text
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: "{{raw_document}}"
      field: document_content
      format: plain_text
    output: document_text

  - id: extract_business_rules
    op: call_webhook
    params:
      url: langgraph/extract_business_rules
      method: POST
      body:
        document_text: "{{document_text}}"
        instruction: "Identify and extract individual business rules from the process document"
      timeout_seconds: 300
      auth: "{{auth_context}}"
    output: extracted_rules

  - id: validate_rules_structure
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: "{{extracted_rules}}"
      schema: business_rule_schema
      require_fields:
        - rule_id
        - rule_text
        - rule_category
    output: validated_rules

  - id: store_rules
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{validated_rules}}"
      steps:
        - id: write_rule
          op: write_database
          params:
            table: rules
            data:
              rule_id: "{{item.rule_id}}"
              rule_text: "{{item.rule_text}}"
              rule_category: "{{item.rule_category}}"
              status: pending_review
              source_document: "{{raw_document.document_id}}"
    output: stored_rules

  - id: generate_embeddings
    op: loop_records
    params:
      collection: "{{stored_rules}}"
      steps:
        - id: call_embedding_api
          op: call_webhook
          params:
            url: embeddings/generate
            method: POST
            body:
              text: "{{item.rule_text}}"
              dimensions: 4096
            timeout_seconds: 300
          output: rule_embedding
        - id: store_embedding
          op: write_database
          params:
            table: rule_embeddings
            engine: pgvector
            data:
              rule_id: "{{item.rule_id}}"
              embedding: "{{rule_embedding}}"
              dimensions: 4096
              searchable: false
    output: stored_embeddings

  - id: log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      action: business_rule_extraction
      document_id: "{{raw_document.document_id}}"
      rules_count: "{{validated_rules.length}}"
      status: completed
